pillar: P4 用之前先看（範本清單）
caption_zh:
【AI 虛擬角色】本篇由 AI 生成的虛擬角色「步驟」發布，圖像為 AI 生成，並非真人。
AI 回答完，先別轉貼。
第 0 步，先看日期。再用 3 步驟核對：
1. 標出能查證的句子：人名、數字、日期、規定
2. 要求列出出處，再自己打開出處看看
3. 對照原始資料，對不上就以原始資料為準
{工具}的介面也寫了提醒：回答可能有錯（{YYYY/MM/DD}）。
我是步驟，由明說角色工作室創作與營運。我沒有用過任何工具，影片裡的操作由工作室真人錄製，我負責說明。錄影版會發布在 YouTube 頻道「步驟」。
caption_gloss_en:
[AI virtual character] This post is published by the AI-generated virtual character "Buzhou"; the image is AI-generated and is not a real person.
After the AI answers, don't repost it yet.
Step zero: check the date. Then check in 3 steps:
1. Mark the sentences that can be checked: names, numbers, dates, rules
2. Ask it to list its sources, then open the sources yourself
3. Compare with the original material; if they differ, go by the original material
{tool}'s interface also carries a notice: answers may be wrong ({date}).
I'm Buzhou, created and run by Plainspoken Studio. I have not used any tool; the operations in the videos are recorded by a real person at the studio, and I explain. The recorded version will be published on the YouTube channel "Buzhou".
on_screen_label_zh: AI 生成｜虛擬角色（圖上角標，後製加上，不由生成工具繪製）

sources.claim: The tool's own interface or help text says its answers can be wrong (the T1 line 「{工具}的介面也寫了提醒：回答可能有錯（{YYYY/MM/DD}）」). The operator pastes the vendor help-centre page URL, or, if the notice exists only in the interface, names the screenshot file and the date seen in this field. Recalled help-centre domains, unverified: help.openai.com, support.anthropic.com, support.google.com/gemini.
NO FACTUAL CLAIM about any vendor: the three-step check (mark the checkable sentences, ask for the sources and open them, compare with the original material) is the studio's own method.

media.description: R01 master portrait of the openly-AI character 步驟 (waist-up, Outfit A, no hands visible, grey studio backdrop). AI-generated photoreal image; the badge 「AI 生成｜虛擬角色」 is typeset in post and never generated. Identity post for the launch day. Alt text: AI 生成的虛擬角色步驟，示意圖，非真人。
media.shot_prompt: PREFER REUSE: if the approved golden-set file R01_pr_master_v1 exists (assets/buzhou/photoreal/), use it and do not generate a new image; a crop or colour correction is a logged human edit. If it is not yet approved, generate it with the R01 prompt in pipeline/image-pack/buzhou-photoreal.md section 2.2 (Gemini) or 2.3 (ChatGPT); the prompt is not repeated here so the pack stays the single source of truth. Never upload a photograph of any real person. No provider adapter is called by this file; generation is manual until the operator supplies an image-API key (pipeline adapters stay inert).
